lines.en: label beachsixtsuneyo2:
scene tsuneyoramenbeach1
So the four of us make our way down the coast to a seaside ramen shop that just opened its doors last week.
lines.zh: 于是我们四个沿着海岸走，去一家上周才开门的海边拉面店。

lines.en: Word around town is the tori shio ramen there is the best in the whole prefecture.
lines.zh: 镇上的传言说，那儿的盐味鸡汤拉面是全县最好吃的。

lines.en: {size=-2}And while I may not be known to gorge myself upon the mangled carcases of birds when I do nothing but sit in my room and kiss their beaks, everything about me changes once you start to involve things you pulled from the earth.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}虽然我平时除了坐在房间里亲鸟喙，并不会去大啖那些被肢解的鸟尸，可一旦掺进从土里刨出来的东西，我整个人就变了。{/size}

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach2
So here we are and there we were, four human beings without fur. Or scales or beaks, just skin and bones. The most boring creatures ever known.
lines.zh: 于是我们在此，而我们曾在彼——四个没有毛的人类。没有鳞，也没有喙，只有皮包着骨。是世上已知最无聊的生物。

lines.en: As we stop before the paper doors, each girl looks at me and I endure the unwelcome stream of consciousness as days of yore return to me once more. Kaori speaks.
lines.zh: 我们在纸门前停下，每个女孩都看着我，而我只能忍受那股不受欢迎的意识流——往昔的岁月又一次回到我身上。Kaori 开口了。

lines.en: : Noodle store?
lines.zh: : 面店？

lines.en: Then Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 然后是 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : We call them ramen-ya in this country on this world. If you do not conform, I will kill your little girl.
lines.zh: : 在这个世界的这个国家，我们叫它「拉面屋」。你若是不肯入乡随俗，我就杀了你家那个小女孩。

lines.en: : That’s rude, Tsuneyo. Don’t you know? Nao’s immortal ‘fore the fall of snow. So get your facts in check and threats in place or {i}I’ll{/i} slap you in that pretty face.
lines.zh: : 这可太没礼貌了，Tsuneyo。你可知道？Nao 在初雪落下之前是不死之身。所以先把事实查清、把威胁摆正，否则{i}我{/i}就扇你那张漂亮的脸。

lines.en: : Your attraction to me is noted again. Let us fill you with food before we are-
lines.zh: : 你对我的垂青我再次记下了。在我们——之前，先让你被食物填满吧。

lines.en: : Friend!
lines.zh: : 朋友！

lines.en: : These endless, violent utterings never cease to annoy me.
lines.zh: : 这些没完没了的暴力言辞，永远让我心烦。

lines.en: : Why stand here when the chairs are inside? Nao-chan tells us we must hide! And if we do not abide by the rules she decides, a demon will come and capture her eyes!
lines.zh: : 椅子都在里头，何必站在这儿？Nao-chan 说我们必须躲起来！要是我们不遵守她定的规矩，就会有恶魔来把她的眼睛抓走！

lines.en: : Which one(s)? I’ve already lost two of the one that is greener. So a third or a fourth might just make me act meaner.
lines.zh: : 哪几只？那只偏绿的眼睛我已经丢过两只了。再来第三只第四只，说不定只会让我变得更凶。

lines.en: : Who needs eyes at all when ramen exists? You should know that a nose is what helps you persist.
lines.zh: : 既然有拉面在，谁还需要眼睛？你该知道，让人撑下去的是鼻子。

lines.en: : Can we stop this conversation and just make our reservation? I didn’t come here to stand, I came for vacation.
lines.zh: : 能不能别聊了，直接去订位？我来这儿不是为了站着，是为了度假。

lines.en: : Onward, Friend! To the “ya” we will venture! Then consume strands of wheat ‘til our hearts are indentured to serve in the kitchen ‘til our teeth become dentures.
lines.zh: : 前进吧，朋友！我们要去闯一闯那间「屋」！然后吞下一根根麦面，直到我们的心被抵押，要在厨房里服劳役，直到牙齿变成假牙。

lines.en: : This is no place for slanted repetition. Let my experience guide you in each future decision.
lines.zh: : 这里可不是玩歪诗接龙的地方。让我用经验来指引你未来的每一个决定。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach3
: If you know something’s real, but it feels like a dream, the best way to escape’s to establish routine.
lines.zh: : 若你明知某事为真，却觉得像场梦，最好的脱身之法，就是建立日常。

lines.en: : I will prepare you dinner behind this counter. I hope you like flounder.
lines.zh: : 我会在这张吧台后面为你准备晚饭。希望你喜欢比目鱼。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, that’s bad. You don’t have a job here. You work in the ya with your father, my dear.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，这不对。你不在这儿打工。你是跟你父亲在那间屋里干活，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Call me “dear” again and I’ll serve your hands first. Just they may be returned for tasting too much like dirt.
lines.zh: : 再叫我一声「亲爱的」，我就先把你的手端上去。谁让它们尝起来太像泥。

lines.en: : Have you been digging again, Friend? For the ghosts of your past? Is {i}that{/i} why you said  all that stuff about plants?
lines.zh: : 你又去挖了？朋友。挖你过去的鬼魂？{i}所以{/i}你才说了那一堆关于植物的话？

lines.en: : Pants?
lines.zh: : 裤子？

lines.en: : {i}Plants!{/i} Everything changes when pulled from the earth. I left out some words of the thoughts that I heard.
lines.zh: : 是{i}植物！{/i}凡是从土里拔出来的东西，都会改变一切。我把听到的那些念头，漏掉了几个词。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach4
: Frankly, Kaori, I think reading my thoughts is a bit too uncouth for a half-god, half-human like you. You should be more like Tsuneyo and lie to me too.
lines.zh: : 老实说，Kaori，我觉得像你这样的半神半人，读我的心思有点太没教养了。你该多学学 Tsuneyo，也对我撒谎。

lines.en: : Do not call me a liar. I’m merely a thief. Just it’s stories I steal as I boil various forms of meat. Primarily pork.
lines.zh: : 别叫我骗子。我只是个小偷。我偷的是故事，一边煮着各种肉的时候偷。主要是猪肉。

lines.en: : Where is my fork?
lines.zh: : 我的叉子呢？

lines.en: : You will use chopsticks and you will like it.
lines.zh: : 你会用筷子，而且你会喜欢的。

lines.en: : It’s unfair that your service is so anti-hybrid!
lines.zh: : 你们的服务这么反混血，太不公平了！

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach5
: Wait! A word there reminded me I’ve been here before! Those days of yore mentioned aren’t long gone from yours!
lines.zh: : 等等！那儿有个词提醒了我——我来过这儿！你说的那些往昔岁月，并没有从你身上远去！

lines.en: : Which you do you mean, Friend? Which you is the me?
lines.zh: : 朋友，你说的是哪个「你」？哪个你才是我？

lines.en: : I am also intrigued by this odd choice of speech.
lines.zh: : 我也对这种古怪的说话方式很好奇。

lines.en: : If you know something we don’t, why not share it and see? Maybe one of us knows of these thoughts you don’t speak.
lines.zh: : 既然你知道我们不知道的事，何不说出来看看？也许我们当中有人知道那些你没说出口的念头。

lines.en: : Twice now, I’ve come here. And each time was odd. Like this doesn’t exist and the shop is a fraud.
lines.zh: : 我已经来过两次了。每一次都很怪。就好像这地方根本不存在，这家店是个骗局。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach6
: Perhaps it’s alive like the town that we live in? And its existence exists just to keep something hidden?
lines.zh: : 也许它跟我们住的那个镇子一样是活的？而它的存在，就是为了把什么东西藏起来？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach7
: I hope it’s a kitten.
lines.zh: : 我希望是只小猫。

lines.en: : I hope that it’s not. This shop would break code and I’d need to be shot.
lines.zh: : 我希望不是。这家店会违反规章，而我得被枪毙。

lines.en: : The Produce Delivery Administration won’t tolerate any sort of deviation from the agreement we made when we made this location.
lines.zh: : 农产品配送管理局不会容忍任何偏离——我们当初选定这个地点时达成的协议，一点都不能差。

lines.en: : Wait, you’re saying you built this? {i}Your{/i} hands are the hands that help me reminisce?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是说这地方是你建的？{i}你的{/i}手，就是帮我回忆的那双手？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach8
: It’s not reminiscence if it never once happened. Even {i}this{/i} isn’t real, it’s just something imagined.
lines.zh: : 如果从未发生过，那就不是回忆。就连{i}此刻{/i}也不真实，只是想象出来的东西。

lines.en: : But if this isn’t real and we’re not really here; why does it feel like we are?
lines.zh: : 可如果这不真实、我们也不真的在这儿，为什么感觉这么像？

lines.en: : Cause a dream that we share is still just a dream and we’re still just as lost as the stars.
lines.zh: : 因为我们共做的梦终究只是梦，我们依旧和群星一样迷惘。

lines.en: : Astronomy isn’t your strong suit. We’ve already mapped their locations. It’s no wonder you failed in your last occupation.
lines.zh: : 天文学可不是你的强项。它们的位置我们早测绘过了。难怪你上一份工作干砸了。

lines.en: : The sentiment was right though. That shared hallucinations are mental proclamations that each dream that we dream is more like an invocation.
lines.zh: : 不过那份心意是对的。共同的幻觉是心灵的宣言——我们做的每一个梦，都更像一次召唤。

lines.en: : Of what?
lines.zh: : 召唤什么？

lines.en: : A butt? A hut? Some strange type of nut?
lines.zh: : 一个屁股？一间小屋？某种奇怪的坚果？

lines.en: : I’d say that it’s more like a door that won’t shut.
lines.zh: : 要我说，更像一扇关不上的门。

lines.en: scene onthebeach1
: Or a gate, if you will. Where there’s no door at all. So the door leads to nowhere and further we fall.
lines.zh: : 或者说一道门扉，如果你愿意。那里根本没有门。于是门通向虚无，而我们越坠越深。

lines.en: : Into what, may I ask? For those gates serve a purpose. And that purpose is more than a reason to hurt us.
lines.zh: : 请问坠入什么？那些门扉自有其目的。而那目的，不只是为了伤害我们。

lines.en: : In some cases, yes. In others, you’re wrong. Sometimes they mean nothing, like the words in a song.
lines.zh: : 有些情况下，是的。另一些情况下，你错了。有时它们毫无意义，就像歌里的词。

lines.en: : Is music not real? If it’s not, just what {i}is?{/i}
lines.zh: : 音乐难道不真实吗？如果它不真实，那什么才{i}真实{/i}？

lines.en: : This is beginning to border on nonsense. Cheese whiz.
lines.zh: : 这开始有点胡说八道了。我的天。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach9
: Listen. All that I’m saying is this isn’t new. That I’ve been here before and you may have too.
lines.zh: : 听着。我想说的只有一件事——这不是新鲜事。我来过这儿，你们可能也来过。

lines.en: : Look deep in your minds or your hearts or whatever. Wrap your fingers around each cord you can sever. Then tear them to pieces and pull every lever. What do you remember?
lines.zh: : 往你们的心里、脑子里、随便哪儿深处看。用手指缠住每一根能割断的绳，然后把它们撕成碎片，拉下每一根拉杆。你们还记得什么？

lines.en: : I remember no gate, nor a door that won’t shut. I remember a beach. I remember no hut.
lines.zh: : 我不记得什么门扉，也不记得关不上的门。我只记得一片海滩。我不记得什么小屋。

lines.en: : I remember no butt or strange type of nut! But I think there is something. It’s a little...It’s...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我也不记得什么屁股或奇怪的坚果！可我好像想起了什么。就一点点……是……呃……

lines.en: : What is it, Kaori? What do you see?
lines.zh: : 是什么，Kaori？你看见了什么？

lines.en: : I don’t see myself. Just the me within me.
lines.zh: : 我没看见我自己。只看见我里面的那个我。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach10
: It was here you once stood when you recalled your name. When the visions of her went and drove you insane.
lines.zh: : 你曾站在这儿，就在你想起自己名字的时候。就在那些关于她的幻象把你逼疯的时候。

lines.en: : But if that wasn’t real and it managed to change you, is “real” really relevant to the changes we go through?
lines.zh: : 可如果那不是真的，却依然改变了你，那「真实」对于我们经历的改变，真的还重要吗？

lines.en: : I think I can see what the spider is saying, but the threads in each fabric of logic are fraying.
lines.zh: : 我想我能明白那只蜘蛛在说什么，可每一块逻辑之布上的线都在散开。

lines.en: : What’s real is the truth, what’s fake is what’s not. And if fiction can change you, you’re weak and you’ll rot.
lines.zh: : 真的就是真相，假的就是假。若虚构也能改变你，那你就是软弱，你会腐烂。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Lies.
lines.zh: : 谎言。

lines.en: : A flaw in design.
lines.zh: : 设计上的缺陷。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach11
: There is no {i}flaw{/i} at all in just reading one’s lines! If our feelings are scripted, they’re still {i}felt,{/i} not denied!
lines.zh: : 照着台词念，本身毫无{i}缺陷{/i}可言！就算我们的感情是写好的，那也照样被{i}感受到{/i}，而不是被否认！

lines.en: : But they’re not felt the way they would be if they weren’t. So if you feel them at all, you’ll get killed by the current. It’ll drag you under and you’ll wish that you weren’t-
lines.zh: : 可那份感受，终究不同于它们本该被感受的样子。所以只要你还在感受，就会被暗流淹死。它会把你拖下去，你会希望自己不是——

lines.en: : A creature so worthless that it’s more a deterrent.
lines.zh: : 一个毫无价值、更像是个警告的生物。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach12
: Precisely. No one will love you if your thoughts aren’t yours. That’s why I make the meals and the spider cleans floors.
lines.zh: : 正是。如果你的念头不属于你自己，就没人会爱你。所以我做饭，那只蜘蛛擦地板。

lines.en: : Lies again, tenchou! That mindset is rotten! Your persuasion befits those with tails made of cotton!
lines.zh: : 又是谎言，店长！这套想法烂透了！你那套说辞，只配给长着棉花尾巴的人听！

lines.en: : A thought’s still a thought if it isn’t your own! Like a house is a house if it isn’t a home! No wonder you’ve ended up alone!
lines.zh: : 就算念头不属于你，它依然是个念头！就像房子就算不成其为家，它依然是房子！难怪你最后落得孤身一人！

lines.en: : Both of you, cease. Quit your yelling this instant. I wouldn’t have come here if I’d known we’d grow distant.
lines.zh: : 你们两个，住口。立刻停止吵闹。早知道我们会变得这么疏远，我根本不会来。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach13
: You assume that you’ve come here at all on this visit. Now get in the kitchen and be my assistant.
lines.zh: : 你还真以为自己这次是来了。现在给我进厨房，当我的助手。

lines.en: : And assist you with what? The erasure of persistence? How to resist one’s instinctual resistance?
lines.zh: : 帮你做什么？抹除那份执着？教你如何抵抗自己本能的抵抗？

lines.en: : No. Making noodles, you fucking idiot. Get out of my store and return to the sand.
lines.zh: : 不。是做面条，你这个白痴。滚出我的店，回沙滩上去。

lines.en: : Sand is better than snow. It’s closer to land.
lines.zh: : 沙子比雪好。它离陆地更近。

lines.en: : I need to stop coming here, willing or not, when each visit expands on this world’s complex plot.
lines.zh: : 不管情愿不情愿，我都得别再来这儿了——每来一次，这个世界的复杂剧情就又展开一层。

lines.en: : If you think it’s bad now, just wait ‘til tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 你要是觉得现在已经够糟，那就等着明天吧。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach14
: You might have to return that body you’ve borrowed.
lines.zh: : 你也许得把你借来的那具身体还回去了。

lines.en: : How excited I am to consume all your sorrows if you fail once again and wind up all hollow.
lines.zh: : 要是你再次失败、最终变得空空荡荡，我该有多兴奋地享用你所有的悲伤。

lines.en: : Did I miss something here? Are you two finally friends? Or was the plot so complex that that I lost it in the end?
lines.zh: : 我是不是错过了什么？你们俩终于成朋友了？还是说剧情太复杂，我到最后跟丢了？

lines.en: : You’ve lost nothing yet, we’re just playing pretend.
lines.zh: : 你什么也没丢，我们只是在过家家。

lines.en: : A year overdue isn’t bad...is it, Friend?
lines.zh: : 晚了一年也不算糟……对吧，朋友？

lines.en: : Overdue for what? Can someone explain? All this back and forth rhyming is frying my brain.
lines.zh: : 什么晚了一年？谁能解释一下？你们这一来一回的押韵快把我脑子烤焦了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach15
: It’s simple in practice, but hard to describe.
lines.zh: : 做起来简单，说起来难。

lines.en: : It’s easy to run, and harder to hide.
lines.zh: : 逃跑容易，藏起来难。

lines.en: : Behind the scenes, this world kept on turning. An accident happened while you were stuck in here learning.
lines.zh: : 在幕后，这个世界一直在转。当你被困在这儿学东西的时候，发生了一场事故。

lines.en: : It has happened before, it’ll happen once more! Your intuition was right when you mentioned a door!
lines.zh: : 它以前发生过，还会再发生一次！你提到门的时候，直觉是对的！

lines.en: : It’s shutting as we speak. The lowest lows and highest peaks. Yet you’re still in your room, still kissing those beaks, as tragedy blankets the beach like its sleet.
lines.zh: : 它此刻正在关闭。最低的低谷，最高的巅峰。可你还待在自己房间里，还在亲那些鸟喙，而悲剧正像雨雪一样覆盖这片海滩。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoramenbeach16
: Your meal is complete. Bon appetit.
lines.zh: : 您的餐点已完成。祝您胃口好。

lines.en: A bowl full of noodles and black garlic sludge — a pinch of my sleeve misconstrued for a tug.
lines.zh: 一碗面条和黑蒜泥——我的袖子被人捏了一下，却被误解成拉了一把。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, may I ask? Would you like a taste, Nao? Close your eyes and say “ahh,” then just open your mouth.
lines.zh: : 请问怎么了？想尝一口吗，Nao？闭上眼睛说「啊——」，然后把嘴张开。

lines.en: : Oh my. It appears she isn’t hungry at all.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。看来她一点也不饿。

lines.en: : Eat your noodles, Nao-chan! It’s the only way you’ll grow tall.
lines.zh: : 把面吃了，Nao-chan！这是你能长高的唯一办法。

lines.en: : Is it cavities? Gravity? I’ve heard the pain is worst before the fall.
lines.zh: : 是蛀牙？还是地心引力？我听说坠落之前，痛得最厉害。

lines.en: : While it’s true that the pressure here compels me to crawl, I think what we’re seeing is compassion. Something’s spurred her to action, just her actions are stalled.
lines.zh: : 虽说这里的压力确实逼得我想爬行，但我觉得我们看到的其实是怜悯。有什么东西驱使她行动了，只是她的行动卡住了。

lines.en: : What a curious thrall.
lines.zh: : 真是奇妙的束缚。

lines.en: : Have you heard of the mall?
lines.zh: : 你听说过那家商场吗？

lines.en: : It opens again soon, doesn’t it? I hope it’s the same way I remember it. And that it doesn’t require a membership.
lines.zh: : 它很快又要开业了，对吧？希望还是我记忆中的样子。也希望不需要会员卡。

lines.en: : Seriously, stop touching me. My hands are damaged enough as is. The last thing I need’s more temptation from kids.
lines.zh: : 说真的，别碰我了。我的手本来就伤得够呛。我最不需要的，就是再被小孩子撩拨。

lines.en: : Why not give her a taste and then take turns with us?
lines.zh: : 为什么不让她尝一口，然后轮到我们？

lines.en: : I’m still looking for cock, bro. Will you come sate my lust?
lines.zh: : 我还在找鸡巴呢，老兄。你来满足我的欲火好吗？

lines.en: : If I’ve won your trust, sure. But I’d like to ask you a question first. I’ve heard Sally sells seashells, but I don’t know what they’re worth.
lines.zh: : 如果我赢得了你的信任，当然。不过我想先问你一个问题。我听说 Sally 卖贝壳，可我不知道它们值多少钱。

lines.en: : I see. You ask for an appraisal in exchange for your girth.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。你用你的尺寸，来换一句估价。

lines.en: : Those shells are worth their weight in gold. And they weigh quite a bit from what I’ve been told.
lines.zh: : 那些贝壳价值等重的黄金。而听人说，它们还挺沉的。

lines.en: : Consider me sold. Now take off that suit and come swim in the cold lest your feet have gone with it and wrapped your heart in a chokehold.
lines.zh: : 算我答应了。现在脱掉那身泳衣，来冷水里游一游吧——免得你的脚也跟着去了，还把你的心勒得喘不过气。

lines.en: : I would still like to swim in the sins that you’ve crafted. But I’m afraid if I leave here, my slit won’t be shafted. Will you give me your word? Even if I’m a bird?
lines.zh: : 我依然想在你编织的那些罪孽里畅游。可我怕一旦离开这儿，我的缝就得不到那根柱。你能给我一句承诺吗？哪怕我只是一只鸟？

lines.en: : It’s birds I love most. That’s why I fell for {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我最爱的就是鸟。所以我才会为{i}她{/i}倾心。

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : Uh-oh?
lines.zh: : 哎呀？

lines.en: : Should timing so poor not win some sort of award? Or perhaps a reward from the ward of the board?
lines.zh: : 这么糟的时机，难道不该拿个什么奖吗？或者从委员会的监护人那儿领份赏？

lines.en: : Which board do you speak of? Because a gift’s already been prepared. And it will soon be delivered by a girl with red hair.
lines.zh: : 你说的是哪个委员会？因为礼物已经备好了。很快就会由一个红头发的女孩送来。

lines.en: : The small one or the large one — who lives inside of me?
lines.zh: : 是小的那个，还是大的那个——住在我里面的那个？

lines.en: : The one who comes from the sea.
lines.zh: : 从海里来的那个。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t. And if you’re going to slander my daughter, I will lead you both to slaughter.
lines.zh: : 我不明白。而且你要是敢诋毁我女儿，我就把你们两个都带去屠宰场。

lines.en: : She doesn’t come from the sea, she comes from the {i}seed.{/i} And that seed comes from me. Probably. Or at least that’s what I believe.
lines.zh: : 她不是从海里来的，她是从{i}种子{/i}里来的。而那颗种子来自我。大概吧。至少我是这么相信的。

lines.en: : Because that’s what you need?
lines.zh: : 因为那是你需要的？

lines.en: : Because that helps you breathe?
lines.zh: : 因为那能让你呼吸？

lines.en: : Let go of my sleeve!
lines.zh: : 放开我的袖子！

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Hahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: Such a wondrous night, this night full of wonder. Free of blunder and thunder, but the time’s come for slumber.
lines.zh: 多么奇妙的夜晚，这个满是奇迹的夜晚。没有过失，也没有雷鸣，但睡觉的时候到了。

lines.en: So I slurp down the soup and I’m hit by a car. A figurative one. Not the type that leaves scars.
lines.zh: 于是我呼噜呼噜喝下汤，然后被一辆车撞了。是比喻意义上的车。不是那种会留下疤的。

lines.en: I stare up at the stars and I make my injuries known. Show three little girls that it’s time to go home.
lines.zh: 我仰望星空，把自己的伤亮出来。让三个小女孩知道，该回家了。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Ah.
: Weren’t we supposed to do something? Involving pillows, pajamas, and the pain of progression?
lines.zh: : 我们不是该做点什么吗？关于枕头、睡衣，还有「前进的痛苦」？

lines.en: : I believe that we may have planned some sort of session.
lines.zh: : 我想我们大概是计划过某种会。

lines.en: : Then will both of you leave here before you’ve learned a new lesson? How to run before walking when you deal with depression?
lines.zh: : 那你们两个能不能在又学到新一课之前离开这儿？如何面对抑郁时，还没学会走就先学会跑？

lines.en: : I think we have to — for I hear the ocean calling. And if my days left are numbered, it’s not good to be stalling.
lines.zh: : 我想我们得走了——因为我听见大海在呼唤。而如果我的日子已经不多，那拖延可不是好事。

lines.en: : Yay, she finally let go.
lines.zh: : 好耶，她终于松手了。

lines.en: : She finally knows.
lines.zh: : 她终于知道了。

lines.en: : Just look at her frown like a clown with no nose.
lines.zh: : 瞧她那张脸，皱得像个没有鼻子的小丑。

lines.en: : A faker, a fraud. One who’s paid without laughter. One who shows up and takes and doesn’t look back after.
lines.zh: : 一个骗子，一个冒牌货。一个拿钱却不带笑声的人。一个来了就索取、走后从不回头看的人。

lines.en: : She’s just like me.
lines.zh: : 她跟我一样。

lines.en: : She’s just like you.
lines.zh: : 她跟你一样。

lines.en: : She’s just like you.
lines.zh: : 她跟你一样。

lines.en: scene black
Once more I leave the ramen stand, somewhat earlier than planned. Then abandon it all as I walk through the sand.
lines.zh: 我再一次离开拉面摊，比计划早了一些。然后在穿过沙滩时，把这一切都抛在身后。

lines.en: Tsuneyo’s beside me, and we come to our senses at the same time. Our words no longer rhyme.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 在我身边，我们同时回过神来。我们的话不再押韵了。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Uhh-
: {i}*Sniff*{/i}
: What are you-
lines.zh: : 你在——

lines.en: : I know that scent.
lines.zh: : 我认得这个味道。

lines.en: : Why are you sniffing me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么在闻我？

lines.en: : You smell like home. Why?
lines.zh: : 你闻起来像家。为什么？

lines.en: : Your guess is as good as mine. I don’t even remember leaving the inn.
lines.zh: : 你要是知道，那我跟你一样知道。我连自己是什么时候离开旅馆的都不记得了。

lines.en: : Peculiar. Neither do I.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我也不记得。

lines.en: : Did we have sex again? Am I going to purge every instance of this from my mind? You must be very bad.
lines.zh: : 我们又做爱了吗？我是不是又要再一次把这件事从脑子里清除掉？你一定很不行。

lines.en: : We have never had sex, Tsuneyo. But we might have time to change that if- oh, fuck.
lines.zh: : 我们从来没做过爱，Tsuneyo。不过我们也许还有时间改变这一点，如果——哦，操。

lines.en: : Yes. Fuck, indeed.
lines.zh: : 是啊。操，没错。

lines.en: : No, I mean we were supposed to be back in my room an hour ago. How the hell did we waste so much time out here?
lines.zh: : 不，我是说我们一小时前就该回我房间了。我们到底是怎么在这儿浪费掉这么多时间的？

lines.en: : Well, at least we have now confirmed it was not sexual in nature as you would not have lasted more than five minutes at most with a goddess like me.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少我们现在确认了那不是性行为——因为面对我这样的女神，你撑死也撑不过五分钟。

lines.en: : Let’s just...get back now and hope that no one’s pissed off at us.
lines.zh: : 我们……先回去吧，希望没人生我们的气。

lines.en: scene black
: I am fine with them being pissed off at you. I would like to remain loved by everyone, though. It may potentially increase the sales of my family’s business.
lines.zh: : 他们生你的气我没意见。不过我希望自己能被所有人喜欢。这说不定能提高我家店的营业额。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see your priorities are as straight as always...
lines.zh: : 我真高兴看到你的人生优先级还是一如既往地笔直……

lines.zh: {i}Tsuneyo 的好感度提升到了 [tsuneyo_love]!{/i}
